description_en: Creates a one-time virus scan task that is immediately executed
description_zh: 创建病毒扫描一次性任务
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-virus-scan-once-task --selection-key 845de1ec-4b08-42e1-b564-31321e48xxxx --scan-type system --scan-path /var/spool/cron --param additionType_:_SCAN_MEMORY --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirusScanOnceTask
